title: Most children jump off the ground with both feet by about 30 months
summary: Most children jump off the ground with both feet by about 30 months, the US CDC says.
body: Both feet leave the floor together. The CDC 30-month movement line says jumps off the ground with both feet, among things most children do by 30 months. Hopping on a single foot is not the line. The card stops at that two-foot jump. The figure is American. It does not bind one child, and a list from elsewhere can name another age.

sources.title: Milestones by 30 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: Movement line: Jumps off the ground with both feet.
